thread:
Maya: heads-up — Horizon-v1 (ptq/int8) canary showing a parse/regression on funcall outputs. sample=2000, parse_fail=160 (8.0%) vs fp16 mirror 6 failures (0.3%). saving traces.

Kiran: ouch. any pattern?

Maya: two patterns stand out: (1) model emits arguments as a JSON-string (double-escaped) e.g. \"arguments\": \"{\\\"user\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\" vs as an object, (2) truncated suffixes (missing closing braces) when KV prefix ~long. also occasional trailing commas and bare newlines inside strings.

Sam: paste examples: 
```
REQUEST: {"prompt":"call fetch_orders(user=42)","function_call":{"name":"fetch_orders"}}
RESPONSE (stream): ..."function_call":{"name":"fetch_orders","arguments":"{\"user\":42,\"limit\":10}"}...
```
and a truncation case: 
```
..."function_call":{"name":"fetch_orders","arguments":{"user":42,"items":["a","b"]
```
(no closing braces)

Maya: canary settings had temp=0.55 for diversity. avg toolcall token_len +10% on int8 vs fp16 -> more chance for cutoffs.

Kiran: quick mitigation ideas: (A) install a canary-only tolerant/rescue parser that attempts: (1) if value is a string -> try JSON.parse(inner) (2) try fix simple issues (trailing comma, unescaped newlines) (3) if NDJSON-ish blank lines, skip empties. record a \"rescue_applied\" flag and original payload. (B) add small goldens targeting nested arrays/long arguments in canary. (C) block rollout beyond canary if post-rescue fail >1%.

Sam: agree. also add single retry path: if rescue fails, do one mirrored fp16 retry (cheap) before returning error. avoid multi-retry loops.

perf-bot: perf-bot: micro-bench job queued: horizon-v1-int8 vs fp16 structured-output 1000 prompts.

Maya: I'll put up a PR for the rescue parser + unit tests (lib/parse/rescue). include telemetry fields: original_text, rescue_steps, rescued=true/false, parse_error_code. we must ensure we don't silently change semantics — mark repaired fields in telemetry.

Kiran: add a small fuzzer to the harness that injects: double-escaped strings, trailing commas, unescaped \n, NDJSON blank lines. Sam can do the harness change.

Sam: I can land the fuzzer and run microbench tonight and push results to the canary dashboard. quick triage question: is this more likely tokenization alignment or a PTQ kernel padding effect? traces often end at a non-brace token => points to truncation on stream boundary.

Infra: qa-bot: created ticket INF-2026-113 (assign: eng-ml + infra) \"Horizon-v1 int8 funcall parse regression\". pinned canary.

Maya: short roadmap: 1) deploy rescue parser in canary only, 2) run microbench & fuzzer, 3) if post-rescue fail >1%, halt rollout and escalate to compilers/tokenizer teams.

Kiran: also track extra tokens emitted when rescue applied (cost impact). if rescue significantly increases token usage we may prefer the single fp16 retry instead of expensive repairs.

Sam: noted. I'll include token delta in the bench output and dashboard tile.

Maya: thanks all. will follow up with PR link and bench outputs. tagging for follow-up :eyes:
